title: SEPPA SSB-SLE-100 Electric PET Bottle Blowing Machine
overviewTitle: Overview of SEPPA SSB-SLE-100 Electric PET Bottle Blowing Machine
overviewDescription: The SEPPA SSB-SLE-100 is a high-speed, 10-cavity fully electric stretch blow molding machine designed for maximum energy efficiency and precision. By replacing traditional pneumatic cylinders with servo-driven motors for stretch rod control and mold clamping, the SSB-SLE-100 ensures absolute repeatability and optimal wall thickness distribution bottle after bottle.
overviewsubDescription: Perfect for mineral water, carbonated soft drinks, and sensitive juices, this machine is sized for high-efficiency large-scale production lines looking to minimize operating costs and carbon footprint.
featuresTitle: Key Features of the SEPPA SSB-SLE-100

features.title: Full Servo Drive Control
features.description: Servo motor synchronization across clamping, stretching, and transfer axes ensures precise mechanical movement and minimal wear.

features.title: Energy Recovery System
features.description: Reclaims kinetic energy during deceleration and converts it back into electrical energy, reducing net grid consumption.

features.title: Advanced Heating Tunnel
features.description: Zoned infrared heating with precise lamp intensity modulation ensures the preform reaches the ideal temperature uniformly.

applicationsSubtitle: Designed for versatility, the system runs various beverage and packaging shapes seamlessly.

applications.title: Mineral Water
applications.description: Ensures high-speed lightweight bottle production with consistent base and neck geometry.

applications.title: Carbonated Drinks
applications.description: Maintains high structural rigidity to hold carbonation pressure without deformation.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose Seppa Solutions?
whyChoose.description: With 50 years of engineering leadership, Seppa designs complete line solutions optimized for uptime and lower operational costs.
paragraphs: We test every machine against the customer's actual preforms before shipping.
Our global support network ensures fast commissioning and spare parts availability.

methodology.title: How it Works
methodology.subtitle: Process steps for the electric stretch blow molding system:

steps.title: Preform Infeed
steps.description: Preforms are automatically loaded and oriented before entering the heating zones.

steps.title: Servo Stretching
steps.description: Servo-driven stretch rods stretch the preforms axially at precise speeds.

steps.title: Ejection
steps.description: Finished containers are rapidly cooled and discharged cleanly onto the outfeed line.

faqs.question: What is the output capacity of the SSB-SLE-100?
faqs.answer: It delivers up to 15,000 - 20,000 bottles per hour depending on bottle size and geometry.

faqs.question: Does it support fast mold changeovers?
faqs.answer: Yes, it features a tool-less quick-change mold design that reduces changeover times to under 30 minutes.
